implementation_strategy: Hosted-API pilot with paired per-task calls: for each intent task, (1) baseline: single LLM call requesting one single-pass configuration (direct_configuration_generation_v1); (2) guarded: single LLM call that implements the generate_validate_repair_v1 behaviour internally (prompt asks the model to output an initial config plus up to 4 repair iterations and a final accepted config in structured sections). Deterministic normalization (AST canonicalization) and deterministic verifier invocation are performed by local CPU code. All scoring and audits are automated code modules; no human labour.
public_resources: Public NetOps intent templates and configuration snippets (curated public teaching labs and RFC-style examples)
Open-source AST normalization and canonicalization scripts (stored in execution manifest)
Deterministic network verifier scripts (open-source unit-test corpus included in manifest)
model_and_version_plan: Primary model: gpt-4o (provider: openai_responses) version 2026-08-01 for all generation and repair calls
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection of 50 paired intent-to-configuration tasks derived from public NetOps templates and synthetic variations; mapping and selection code unit-tested and recorded in execution manifest.
transformation_manifest_strategy: All generated configs pass AST normalization and canonicalization prior to verifier invocation; guarded prompt instructs model to present iteration-separated outputs. Semantic-equivalence checks (normalized-AST compare) executed deterministically in CPU code.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic task ordering and batch assignment (precomputed seed), no stochastic reordering to ensure reproducible paired comparisons.
caching_plan: Cache raw LLM responses and verifier outputs in manifest storage keyed by task index and prompt hash; reuse cached responses for re-analysis only; no model-call budget consumed when reading cache.
failure_recovery_plan: On API transient failure, automated retry according to provider idempotency rules up to adapter-allowed model-call budget; technical failures logged and affected pairs excluded from primary McNemar analysis per preregistration; all failure reasons recorded in execution manifest.
result_schema: Paired binary episode: for each task index produce {baseline_config, baseline_verifier_pass:boolean, guarded_config, guarded_verifier_pass:boolean, normalized_ASTs, verifier_logs, repair_iteration_count, flags[]}. Binary outcome for primary estimand: verifier_pass (false => safety violation).
estimated_compute_notes: Worst-case model calls = task_count * 2 = 100; hosted-API calls only (no local GPU). Local CPU used for AST normalization and verifier runs; estimated CPU runtime < 2 vCPU-hours overall. Fits hard capability constraints (maximum_planned_model_calls=10000, local_gpu unavailable).
